name: Profile-shaped board (WP-200): a one-team profile keeps its sport, drops every other
description: The second WP-200 acceptance case: a profile whose only rule is ONE football club. followBroadly is explicit and empty (a team rule is a precise follow, never a wholesale sport follow), and the sports the profile covers is therefore just {football} — the club's own sport. Everything outside football drops, however loud it is: golf-norsk (a Norwegian in the field), f1-imp5 (importance 5) and cycling-norsk all used to reach this board through the un-scoped blanket and no longer do. Inside football the blanket is DELIBERATELY kept — valerenga-hamkam is a Norwegian league match with no tracked entity and stays, because the profile says «this person is in football» and the alternative (an entity gate, chess/esports-style, vector 14) would leave a one-club follower with two rows a month. The blanket is still a blanket and not «all football»: community-shield is football, in scope, and drops because nothing about it fires — not Norwegian, not a favourite, importance below the threshold, no tracked entity. mustWatch is unchanged and sport-scoped (only the club's own match rings). mustSee is unchanged too, and is asserted here precisely to show it was NOT touched: it is a CLIENT accent predicate keyed off event-intrinsic signals (DIVERGENCES §0/§3), so it still fires for golf-norsk and f1-imp5 even though the lens no longer puts them on this user's board.
